in_sanskrit.name: हीना
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Heena is derived from the Sanskrit word हीन (heen), which means 'small', 'young', or 'delicate'. In Sanskrit, the suffix -ा (aa) is added to the root word to form a feminine noun. Thus, Heena is a feminine name that signifies being small, young, or delicate.
